# 2 Baruch Chapter 33 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**33:1** And when I had spoken all these words to the people, I went away and sat in a cave of the earth in the valley of Kidron, and I fasted there for seven days.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering of a transitional one-verse chapter. All three translators are essentially in agreement. Minor variation: EMET "cave of the earth" / LOGOS same / PNEUMA "cave in the Kidron valley." Retained LOGOS which preserves both the "cave of the earth" phrase and the location.*
